contentText: This week, Valérie Fayolle meets Pascal Obispo. His melodies have left their mark on the French musical landscape and he's well known as an author, composer and performer. Now we meet his alter-ego, the painter! Pascal takes us to the Ange Basso gallery in Paris's 6th arrondissement, where his artwork is on currently on show. We also discover Julie Depardieu's one-woman show, "La Misérable" at the Marigny studio. Depardieu plays Juliette Drouet, the woman who was Victor Hugo's mistress for almost 50 years.
